messages.subject: Unposted time — February (reminder)
messages.plaintextBody:
Hi,

Our records show unposted time from February against several matters. Please ensure all narratives are posted by close of play Wednesday so we can run the March bills. Partners, please review and approve drafts in the WIP queue.

Many thanks,
Accounts
Whitfield Carter LLP
